description: I own the pipelines and data models behind the commercial information used by the sales force. I built a Python Analytics Hub that replaced 5 notebooks and 4 standalone scripts, cutting the monthly close to a single parameter change, and validated it against production deliverables with 0 differences. I also built the raw IQVIA ingestion (930 MB fixed-width file, 13.1M records) with control-total reconciliation, an entity resolution pipeline for the CUP to PBS prescription audit migration (1.6M records, 85% match rate), and Power BI dashboards used by managers and reps.

description: Designed a normalized relational data model, with keys and referential integrity, to consolidate construction cost estimates coming from heterogeneous spreadsheets. Implemented it as a centralized database serving as the single source of truth for cost control and project progress, with automated ETL processes in Python and SQL for cleaning, standardization and validation before load.
